messages:
Incident Bot: PAGER: 1855554321 - HIGH ERROR RATE detected for OrchidPay dedicated pool orchid-eu-2. Paging oncall-sre :rotating_light:
Aisha Khan: I'm on it. seeing spike in 502/503 for /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank. Started 08:12:34 UTC.
Devon Li: checking pod status - some workers reporting 'stalled shard' and long GC pauses. Could be tokenizer change in recent bundle orchard-tokenizer:v3.4.
Nate (SRE): I see repeated GC and threads waiting on mem cgroup, OOM events not triggered but memory keeps climbing. suspect memory leak with tokenizer caches.
Priyanka (CS): Heads-up: OrchidPay is enterprise-high-touch. Primary contacts: Elisa Moreno (elisa@orchidpay.com, +44-20-5555-0202), Engineering Manager: Tomas Gutierrez (tomas@orchidpay.com). Notify Elisa immediately if customer impact continues.
Aisha Khan: assigning roles - I will remediate; Nate will prepare rollback; Devon will capture logs and metrics; Priyanka/Lena handle customer comms.
Nate (SRE): Proposed immediate mitigation: reduce worker concurrency and flush tokenizer caches via runtime flag: `redwood admin set-pool-config --pool orchid-eu-2 --worker-concurrency 1 --kv-cache-evict true` then redeploy stable tokenizer `orchid-tokenizer:v3.2`.
Devon Li: log snip: ```08:12:30 runtime[worker]: tokenizer_cache_size=1.4GB
08:12:31 runtime[worker]: GC pause 320ms
08:12:33 runtime[worker]: waiting on cache lock
08:12:34 runtime[worker]: request error 502 downstream
``` 
Aisha Khan: rolling config change now. ETA 2m for eviction and scale down.
Incident Bot: CONFIG_CHANGE job-9921 started for orchid-eu-2.
Nate (SRE): eviction executed. Worker concurrency set to 1. Restarting workers to apply. Monitoring.
Devon Li: after eviction, memory reduced to ~480MB. Error rate down from 22% -> 6% in 90s.
Aisha Khan: preparing rollback of tokenizer to v3.2 as precaution. `redwood admin rollback --pool orchid-eu-2 --component tokenizer --version v3.2` ETA 6m.
Lena - Account Exec: prepping customer message. Draft for Elisa (phone/SMS): "Elisa - we detected elevated errors on your dedicated pool affecting embeddings and re-ranking. We have applied mitigation and are rolling back a tokenizer bundle; you may see brief retries. We will call you in 20 minutes with details. -Lena (Redwood)"
Priyanka (CS): Status page snippet draft: ```Incident: Elevated 5xx/502 errors for OrchidPay dedicated pool (orchid-eu-2).
Impact: Some requests to embeddings and reranking endpoints returned errors or experienced increased latency.
Timeline: 08:12:34 UTC - Mitigation ongoing. Actions: applied cache eviction and are rolling back tokenizer to validated version. Current status: service degraded but recovering.
Next steps: full RCA and timeline to customers within 24 hours.``` 
Aisha Khan: rollback completed at 08:18:05 UTC. Observability: 5xx -> 0.9% within 2m; latency back to baseline.
Nate (SRE): confirming no persistent mem growth, workers stable. No persistent GC pauses.
Priyanka (CS): Sent SMS to Elisa at 08:20 UTC; left voicemail and scheduled 30m follow-up call. Elisa requested copy of timeline and ask for permanent canary gating.
Aisha Khan: internal paste for #incidents (ready): "[Incident 1855554321] OrchidPay - orchid-eu-2 saw elevated 502/503 due to tokenizer cache regression in tokenizer v3.4. Mitigated via cache eviction and rollback to v3.2 (08:18 UTC). No data loss; ingest and customer data unaffected. Action items: add tokenizer memory tests to preflight, longer canary, automated cache eviction on spike. Oncall: Aisha Khan."
Devon Li: capturing RCA log excerpt for later: ```08:11:59 deploy: tokenizer:v3.4 went live
08:12:30 runtime: cache size growth spike
08:12:34 gateway: surge of 502
08:18:05 rollback: tokenizer v3.2 succeeded
``` 
Ops Lead: Schedule RCA tomorrow 09:30 UTC with Runtime, SRE, CS, and QA. Assign action owners and track in incident board.
Priyanka (CS): Customer-facing email template (short): ```Subject: Incident report - OrchidPay dedicated inference pool (orchid-eu-2)
Hi Elisa,
We investigated an incident on [date] that caused intermittent errors for your dedicated inference pool. Summary: At 08:12 UTC a tokenizer bundle introduced unexpected cache growth, resulting in elevated 502/503 errors for embeddings and reranking. Mitigation: we performed cache eviction and rolled back the tokenizer to v3.2 at 08:18 UTC. Impact window: ~08:12 - 08:18 UTC. No customer data was affected. Next steps: we'll share a full RCA and permanent mitigation plan within 24 hours. Apologies for the disruption; we are prioritizing canary and pre-deploy memory checks.
— Priyanka (Redwood)
``` 
Aisha Khan: closing note: incident resolved; leaving thread open until RCA. Thanks all for quick coord. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT 1855554321 status: resolved (acknowledged).
